Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mad...@rocketmail.com wrote:
> Ok, since STI has been reworded, can you pull a counter from it and also still
> pull blood from blood dolls? Just curious.

Yes. Pulling a blood from a blood doll is something you can do during
your master phase. It doesn't require a Master Phase Action. It can be
done whether or not you spend you Master Phase Action(s) doing other
things.
